# Schedule Now Available for KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + OpenInfra Summit + PyTorch Conference China – PyTorch
AI is transforming how we build, deploy, and operate technology. Open source is making it possible.
[KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + OpenInfra Summit + PyTorch Conference China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/) will take place September 7-9 in [Shanghai](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/attend/venue-travel/).
[The schedule is now available](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/), featuring engineers, maintainers, researchers, and technology leaders advancing cloud native infrastructure, open infrastructure, and AI.
## Session Highlights
- [Scaling Digital Employees at China Merchants Bank in Production: A Controlled AI Agents Approach](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1225364) — Jiahang Xu, China Merchants Bank
- [How Intsig Serves Billions of Document Scans: GPU Virtualization at Scale with HAMi](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1221808) — Xiao Zhang, dynamia.ai and Walter Duan, instig information co. ltd.
- [Spec-Driven Evolution: How AI Agents are Rewriting the OpenStack/K8s Playbook](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1224932) — Bertran Souveill, DOCOMO Euro-Labs and Yuya Kuno, NTT DOCOMO
- [From Cloud to AI: How Kata Containers 4.0 Reinvents the Sandbox for the Agent Era](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1220661) — Fupan Li, Ant Group
- [The State of the PyTorch Ecosystem in 2026: Global Trends and China’s Rising Role](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1225138) — Wei Wang, East China Normal University
- [Training Through Failures: How Meta Keeps 100k-GPU Jobs Alive with Open-Source Fault Tolerance](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1223450) — Tristan Rice and Amir Afzali, Meta
[View the full schedule](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/).
## Registration
Registration information is available on the event website. [Register here.](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/register/)
[Learn more about registration options and what is included](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/register/#whats-included).
## Co-Located Events
### OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China
[OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/) will take place on September 7. The half-day event covers the evolution of Open Source Program Management (OSPO) functions and corporate open source governance in the era of Agentic AI.
[Registration details](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/#registration-details) and the [call for proposals](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/#call-for-proposals) are available online.
### AGNTCon + MCPCon China
[AGNTCon + MCPCon China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/mcp-dev-summit-shanghai/) will take place September 6-7 ahead of the main event. The event focuses on building reliable, scalable, and secure agent systems in practice.
[Registration information is available here](https://www.lfopensource.cn/mcp-dev-summit-shanghai/register/).

# KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + OpenInfra Summit + PyTorch Conference China 議程公布
AI 正在改變我們建置、部署與維運技術的方式；開源讓這一切成為可能。
[KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + OpenInfra Summit + PyTorch Conference China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/) 將於 9 月 7 日至 9 日在[上海](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/attend/venue-travel/)舉行。
[議程現已公布](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/)，內容涵蓋推動雲端原生基礎設施、開放基礎設施與 AI 發展的工程師、維護者、研究人員與技術領袖。
## 精選議程
- [招商銀行如何在生產環境擴大數位員工規模：受控式 AI 代理方法](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1225364) — Jiahang Xu，招商銀行
- [Intsig 如何服務數十億次文件掃描：以 HAMi 大規模實作 GPU 虛擬化](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1221808) — Xiao Zhang，dynamia.ai；Walter Duan，instig information co. ltd.
- [規格驅動的演進：AI 代理如何改寫 OpenStack/K8s 的實務手冊](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1224932) — Bertran Souveill，DOCOMO Euro-Labs；Yuya Kuno，NTT DOCOMO
- [從雲端到 AI：Kata Containers 4.0 如何為代理時代重新打造沙盒](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1220661) — Fupan Li，Ant Group
- [2026 年 PyTorch 生態系現況：全球趨勢與中國日益重要的角色](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1225138) — Wei Wang，華東師範大學
- [在故障中持續訓練：Meta 如何用開源容錯機制維持 10 萬 GPU 作業運行](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/?id=1223450) — Tristan Rice、Amir Afzali，Meta
[查看完整議程](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/program/schedule/)。
## 報名
報名資訊可在活動網站上查詢。[點此報名。](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/register/)
[了解更多報名選項與包含內容](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/register/#whats-included)。
## 同場活動
### OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China
[OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/) 將於 9 月 7 日舉行。這場半日活動將探討 Agentic AI 時代下，開源計畫辦公室（Open Source Program Office，OSPO）職能與企業開源治理的演進。
[報名詳情](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/#registration-details)與[提案徵集](https://www.lfopensource.cn/kubecon-cloudnativecon-openinfra-summit-pytorch-conference-china/co-located-events/ospology-ospo-summit/#call-for-proposals)資訊可在線上查詢。
### AGNTCon + MCPCon China
[AGNTCon + MCPCon China](https://www.lfopensource.cn/mcp-dev-summit-shanghai/) 將於主活動前的 9 月 6 日至 7 日舉行。活動聚焦於在實務中打造可靠、可擴充且安全的代理系統。
[報名資訊請見此處](https://www.lfopensource.cn/mcp-dev-summit-shanghai/register/)。
